intent.title: Begin with an issue-resolution workspace
intent.question: What should the browser become first? 1. Issue-resolution workspace: understand issues, answer them, and follow repairs; agents may run elsewhere. 2. Agent workspace: start, steer, pause, and resume agents, with Plumb issues integrated. 3. Project control centre: coordinate multiple repositories, agents, and people.
intent.readback: The owner selected an issue-resolution workspace as the first browser product, with agent activity linked to issues and agents able to run elsewhere.
will: Help the owner understand issues, answer them, and follow the resulting repairs.
Show agent activity relevant to resolving issues.
wont: Make full agent lifecycle management or a multi-person project control centre the initial product scope.
assumptions: Specific execution controls and project coverage remain to be decided during the interview.

decisions.title: The first browser product is an issue-resolution workspace
decisions.question: What should the browser become first?
decisions.chosen: Issue-resolution workspace: understand issues, answer them, and follow repairs; agents may run elsewhere.
alternatives: Agent workspace with start, steer, pause and resume controls.
Project control centre coordinating multiple repositories, agents and people.
decisions.recommended: Issue-resolution workspace: understand issues, answer them, and follow repairs; agents may run elsewhere.
decisions.rationale: The owner explicitly selected option 1 in the discovery interview. The question and exact answer are preserved in the originating intent; host prompt verification is unavailable in this session.
